overview_description.description: Openland is a modern platform for chat communities. Anyone can start a community as a simple chat and add more activies as they grow. Openland provides tools for sharing and organizing community knowledge and connecting community members via 1-1 introductions. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in San Francisco. Openland is backed by 30 prominent venture investors, including Y Combinator, Gagarin Capital, Sinai Ventures, Soma Capital, Liquid 2 Ventures, and Rainfall Ventures.
